Ann Fall

1814–1888

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
Ann Freestone
Born
August 7, 1814 · Aldbrough St John, Yorkshire, England
Died
December 25, 1888 · Alpine, Utah
Burial
Alpine Cemetery, Alpine, Utah

FamilySearch records Ann’s birth as August 7, 1814, in Aldbrough St John, Yorkshire, England. A family sketch calls that date her christening, and the pioneer database gives 1812. She married Thomas Freestone on August 1, 1837, in Crapaud, Prince Edward Island. Their family included eight children. She later married Andrew Hodnett on May 17, 1862, in Salt Lake City. She died December 25, 1888, in Alpine and was buried in Alpine Cemetery.
